learning.title: Learn More About Anxiety
learning.subtitle: Waves only stay for a moment. Learn how to wait for the wave of anxiety to pass.

acc_01.text: The waves may rise high, but they will soon settle.
acc_01.subText: It's okay not to force the anxiety to stay calm.

acc_02.text: The crashing waves are only a part of you, not all of you.
acc_02.subText: Anxiety is just something that passes through you for a moment.

acc_03.text: No matter how rough the waves, your center remains steady.
acc_03.subText: Take a breath and focus on the sensations of the present.

val_01.text: Look beyond the waves to where you truly want to go.
val_01.subText: What matters most to you in this very moment?

val_02.text: Wherever the waves push, simply holding your own direction is enough.
val_02.subText: What matters isn't the height of the waves, but the direction you choose.

act_01.text: One small move you make now creates a big difference.
act_01.subText: Even if you feel anxious, what is the smallest thing you can start right now?

act_02.text: The small steps you've started will eventually reach where you want to be.
act_02.subText: There is real strength in the flow your will creates.

act_03.text: Trust the small steps you took today, rather than grand changes.
act_03.subText: Small actions gather together to complete your precious daily life.

rest_01.text: It's okay to pause and rest for a while. Stillness is a precious moment in life, too.
rest_01.subText: For your tired self, pause everything for a moment and just be.

rest_02.text: Rather than trying to beat the waves, let them flow by and catch your breath.
rest_02.subText: Even without trying hard, you are still more than enough.
